versions.changelog:
Initial release for animated cover video creation in Instagram carousels.

- Generates a cinemagraph-style animated cover (5s, no audio) from a "foto gancho" via Higgsfield.
- Renders the title as a transparent PNG overlay using Chromium and Node.js.
- Delivers three ready-to-use assets: animated video (`cover_anim_raw.mp4`), overlay (`title-overlay.png`), and a static cover (`slide-01.png`).
- Guides users to combine assets in CapCut/Edits, as ffmpeg composition doesn't run on server.
- Integrates selfie management, output paths, asset size limits, and Telegram notifications.
- Supports workflow for both image and video creation, following clear, documented steps.
